title: Recover a classical series by Parseval
promptMarkdown: For $f(x)=x$ on $(-\pi,\pi)$, compute its real sine coefficients and use Parseval to obtain $\sum_{n\ge1}n^{-2}$. Specify the norm and normalisation and explain why no assertion of uniform Fourier convergence is needed.
hintLadder: Use parity, then integrate the sine coefficient by parts.
Track the squared norm of the unnormalised sine functions in Parseval.

criteria.criterion: Computes coefficients with their signs and normalisation.
